RECENT LETTERS · TWO LATEST
L · 22
BRIEF #22 — YEAR 3 RECONCILIATION
FROM E. BRAE · 22 MAR 2026

Dear Margaret,

Three years on, the Cardigan saltmarsh you have backed since 2022 has accreted sediment at 8.2 mm/year — well above the 5.5 mm/year baseline. I have enclosed the third annual sediment survey and the hydrologist's note. The Border Mire allocation, in memory of Peter, has been honoured to the foot: every penny of your December gift was applied to the second drain-blocking tranche, completed Easter weekend.

With warm regards, — E.B.

L · 21
BRIEF #21 — AUDIT COVER NOTE
FROM M. HOLLOWAY · 04 JAN 2026

Dear Margaret,

The independent auditors signed the FY 2024 books on 12 March 2025 with a clean letter, attached. The reconciliation found three minor coding errors (all under £500, all donor-side) which have been corrected in the published ledger. Your aggregated FY 2024 contributions reconcile to £24,815, against which your Gift Aid claim of £5,628.20 has been filed.

Kind regards, — M. Holloway, Treasurer

Quarterly uplift

Listed as M. Holloway

Bequest · Award letter
